# Board Support Levels

What nano-ros can show for each board it knows about. Each level is derived from evidence, never typed: **where** the board's image runs (on a host, in an emulator, on hardware, or nowhere yet), **how often** that run happens (every merge, daily, weekly, or by hand on a date) and **which board's test matrix** stands for its breadth.

| Status | What it means |
|---|---|
| Verified on host / in emulator / on hardware (cadence) | an automated lane boots it and asserts a message, at that cadence |
| Boots, manual (date) | a maintainer booted it by hand on that date; after 120 days it reads *Builds* until booted again |
| Builds | a lane builds it; nothing boots it |
| Not supported | nothing builds or boots it |

A **witness** board runs its platform family's test matrix; a board that **inherits** shares the witness's code path and adds its own smoke evidence. Each board links to its evidence page.

## Infrastructure

Packages under `packages/boards/` that are not boards: shared traits, family drivers, ABI mirrors, PACs and descriptor directories.

`nros-board-common`, `nros-board-cffi`, `nros-board-freertos`, `nros-board-nuttx`, `nros-board-threadx`, `nros-board-threadx-port-riscv64`, `mps2-an385-pac`, `linux`, `zephyr`, `nros-board-qemu-cortex-a53`
